title: The Blue Ribbon Stall
summary: Sabine's prize ribbon is gone, and the empty market stall has two claimants.

stages.text: Sabine says her blue festival ribbon vanished from a hook by her workshop door. She has her suspicions.
stages.hint: Look around the Weaver's Cottage door, and the bakery. People in the square might have seen something.

stages.text: Thread, tracks and a boy who saw something. Time to decide what you believe.
stages.hint: Open the Case Board in your journal (J).

objectives.text: Pick a theory on the Case Board

stages.text: Theories are cheap. The ribbon is somewhere.
stages.hint: Foxes keep dens in the woods south-east, near the heron pool.

stages.text: Muddy, chewed at one end, but whole.
Ada keeps the market roll. She's asked for your view on who should have the empty stall.

completion_text: The second market stall is open again.
